Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision at the
intersection in Sugar Land, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just give you the details of what happened, if that's okay.
Q: That works. For the record, can you confirm you were the driver of the vehicle you were operating at the time?
A: Yes, I was driving my own car that day.
Q: Walk me through what happened as you approached the intersection.
A: I was heading through on a green light. I had slowed down a bit because traffic was heavy. Then a car came from
my right side and pulled out into the intersection, and I couldn't stop in time.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: Only for a second. It was already moving into the lane when I noticed it. I braked hard and turned a little, but it hit
my passenger side.
Q: Did your airbags deploy?
A: Yes, the side curtain and the front one came out. The car was pushed sideways and ended up against the curb.
Q: Were you taken for medical care?
A: An ambulance took me to the hospital. They x-rayed my left arm and found a fracture in the wrist. I'm in a splint
now and I have a follow-up with an orthopedic doctor next week.
Q: Is there anything you feel you should add to your account?
A: Only that I was following the signals and driving carefully. I'm still sore and I can't grip things well with that hand
yet.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
</page>
